The total pies equation with \(t_1=\frac{3t}{4}\) is
\[
3m_p\cdot \frac{3t}{4}+m_p\cdot \frac{t}{4}=60
\]
\[
\frac{9}{4}m_p t+\frac{1}{4}m_p t=\frac{10}{4}m_p t=60
\]
\[
m_p t=24.
\]
The Bear ate pies only during the first phase:
\[
P=3m_p t_1=3m_p\cdot \frac{3t}{4}=\frac{9}{4}m_p t=\frac{9}{4}\cdot 24=54.
\]

\[
\boxed{54}
\]
